title: Embedded SNC resolution on a regular surface
statement: Let $X$ be a integral regular Noetherian excellent scheme of dimension $2$, admitting an ample invertible sheaf [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and let $Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a proper closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion]. There is a finite sequence of blowups at closed points of the successive inverse images of $Z$ whose total inverse image of $Z$ is an effective Cartier divisor supported on a strict normal-crossing divisor. A blowup in an ideal $I$ is $\operatorname{Proj}_X(\bigoplus_{a\geq0}I^a)$ [def-nagata-relative-proj]; its source is again regular. Strict normal crossing means that its reduced irreducible components are regular curves, at most two pass through each point, and two meeting components are locally defined by a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]. The composite is projective and is an isomorphism away from a finite set of closed points of $Z$.
